courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」與「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder" and "Geometry survey and camber feedback" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墩頂變高度箱梁」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Haunched box girder at the pier” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
history.text: 德國 Dyckerhoff & Widmann 公司的 Ulrich Finsterwalder 結合預力鋼棒與懸臂施工，1951 年完成跨度 62 m 的 Balduinstein 蘭河橋，被視為第一座以懸臂工法建造的預力混凝土橋；1965 年完工的 Bendorf 萊茵河橋主跨 208 m，把場鑄平衡懸臂推向大跨度。法國 Campenon Bernard 公司 1962 年在 Choisy-le-Roi 橋首度大規模商業應用預鑄節塊，Jean Muller 隨後發展匹配澆注與節塊架設設備。1998 年挪威 Stolma 橋以約 301 m 主跨創下紀錄，而 1996 年 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的倒塌則提醒工程界長期撓度與補強評估的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Ulrich Finsterwalder of Dyckerhoff & Widmann combined prestressing bars with cantilever construction; the 62 m Balduinstein bridge over the Lahn, finished in 1951, is regarded as the first prestressed concrete bridge built by the free-cantilever method, and the Bendorf Rhine bridge, completed in 1965 with a 208 m main span, pushed cast-in-place balanced cantilevering to long spans. Campenon Bernard made the first major commercial use of precast segments at Choisy-le-Roi in 1962, and Jean Muller went on to develop match casting and segment-erection equipment. Norway's Stolma Bridge set a record main span of about 301 m in 1998, while the 1996 collapse of the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge reminded the profession of the importance of long-term deflection and retrofit assessment. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
